trailhead.label: At the Martin farm on the Streda Cuca above Ortisei

cautions: About 300 m each way of narrower mountain path (T2) beyond the La Tambres farm: keep your dog close and watch its footing.
About 590 m each way on asphalt lanes; the Streda Cuca carries the Ortisei–Costamula bus: keep your dog on a short lead there.
Farmed meadows line the path: Ortisei keeps dogs off them.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Troi da la Tambres, Ortisei: Troi da la Tambres sopra Ortisei, andata e ritorno
textIt.At the Martin farm on the Streda Cuca ab: Al maso Martin sulla Streda Cuca sopra Ortisei
textIt.About 300 m each way of narrower mountai: Circa 300 m per tratta di sentiero di montagna più stretto (T2) oltre il maso La Tambres: tieni il cane vicino e fai attenzione a dove mette le zampe.
textIt.About 590 m each way on asphalt lanes; t: Circa 590 m per tratta su stradine asfaltate; sulla Streda Cuca passa l’autobus Ortisei–Costamula: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.Farmed meadows line the path: Ortisei ke: Il sentiero costeggia prati coltivati: Ortisei vieta ai cani di entrarci.
